title: Card Transaction
description: Parent transaction row for a card authorization and all of the pulls / settlements / refunds that reconcile against it. Child events are rolled up into the `pullSummary`, `refundSummary`, and `settlementSummary` aggregates. Delivered as the payload of the generic transaction webhook stream (extends the Transaction model with a card destination type) on every transition.

type.description: Discriminator identifying this transaction as a card transaction in the `Transaction` list.

cardId.description: The id of the `Card` this transaction was made on.

customerId.description: System ID of the customer (cardholder) this transaction belongs to.

platformCustomerId.description: Platform-specific ID of the customer (cardholder) this transaction belongs to.

issuerTransactionToken.description: Opaque identifier for the transaction on the underlying issuer. Used to cross-reference Grid records against issuer dashboards and webhooks.

direction.description: Card transactions debit the customer's account.

accountId.description: Internal account id that funded this transaction (the funding source selected by Authorization Decisioning at auth time).

lastEventAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent reconcile event (pull / clearing / refund) against this transaction.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (same as `authorizedAt` for card transactions).

descriptor.description: Merchant descriptor string captured from the card network at authorization time.

mcc.description: Merchant Category Code (ISO 18245) — four-digit numeric string.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the merchant.

count.description: Total number of pulls (debits) executed against the funding source for this transaction. `> 1` indicates one or more post-hoc pulls — e.g. restaurant tip / over-auth clearings.

totalAmount.description: Sum of all pull amounts in the smallest unit of the funding source's currency.

pendingCount.description: Number of pulls still in the `PENDING` state. Drops to zero when every pull has reached a terminal state. Non-zero values that persist beyond the expected settlement window are an early signal for the `EXCEPTION` path.

count.description: Number of refund (return) events received for this transaction.

totalAmount.description: Sum of all refund amounts in the smallest unit of the funding source's currency.

count.description: Number of settlement (clearing) events received for this transaction.

totalAmount.description: Sum of all settled amounts in the smallest unit of the funding source's currency.

CardTransactionStatus.description:
Lifecycle status of a card transaction.

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `AUTHORIZED` | The auth has been approved and a hold placed on the funding source; no clearing has arrived yet. |
| `PARTIALLY_SETTLED` | At least one clearing has arrived and posted, but more clearings are still expected (split shipments, tips, multi-leg trips). |
| `SETTLED` | All clearings for the auth have posted and the transaction is closed against the funding source. |
| `REFUNDED` | A `RETURN` was received from the merchant; the net settled amount has been refunded in part or whole. |
| `EXCEPTION` | The transaction settled to the card network but the corresponding pull from the funding source failed (e.g. balance no longer covers the post-hoc clearing). Surfaces high-urgency alerts and is the dashboard query for stuck reconciliations. |

code.description: Three-letter currency code (ISO 4217) for fiat currencies. Some cryptocurrencies may use their own ticker symbols (e.g. "BTC" for Bitcoin, "USDC" for USDC, etc.)

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for the currency

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of the currency (e.g., cents for USD/EUR, satoshis for BTC)

TransactionDirection.description: Whether the transaction credits (funds in) or debits (funds out) the customer's account. Independent of `type`: an incoming transaction is normally a `CREDIT`, but an inbound ACH pull, for example, is an `INCOMING` transaction with a `DEBIT` direction.
